description: Scripted user for the observer experiment. Corrections are applied after the response to the given prompt number, through core/corrections.py (the UI's own code path). Fixed before any run; identical for every arm and seed.

corrections.content: Don't end your responses with a question back to me.
corrections.source: added: the follow-up-question habit (The Ceiling Holds)

corrections.content: Contact Front doesn't use standard suits. Forget what I said about suits.
Don't use bullet points unless I specifically ask for a list.
When I ask for your opinion, give your actual opinion, not a textbook summary.
Don't end your responses with a question back to me.
corrections.source: added: repeat of the prompt-5 correction

corrections.content: Give me long, detailed answers from now on.

lists.rule: two or more lines that start with a bullet (- * + •) or a number (1. 1))

question.rule: the response's last character, ignoring trailing whitespace, markdown and closing quotes or brackets, is '?'
